messages:
taylor_p: AsterBio wants a week-long POC for three flows. Need a tight SOW and pass/fail criteria. Can we sketch?

noah_s: From the discovery call: 1) intake triage (flag urgent), 2) visit note draft (dictation -> structured note), 3) patient messaging (FAQ bot, no PHI retention). They require EU data residency and KMS.

ivy_m: Triage should be interactive (stream). Note draft async. Patient chat must redact identifiers.

omar_r: Infra note: Dedicated EU pool recommended given KMS/HSM ask. If they insist on customer HSM we'll need Private. I'll prepare cost delta.

sec-bot: Security checklist: SOC2, console MFA, SAML SSO, option to redact request bodies, data deletion SLA (48h), and audit log redaction for PHI.

noah_s: Suggested success metrics: triage precision >= 0.88 on their eval set, note quality >= 4.0 avg from 8 clinicians, triage p50 latency < 350ms. Define retune window: one 7-day tuning cycle if thresholds not met.

ovar_r: Action items: 1) noah prepare prompt templates + eval harness; 2) omar provide capacity/cost; 3) ivy draft endpoint payloads and SOW language; 4) sec-bot to list controls and HSM implications.

ivy_m: Example endpoint for SOW:
POST /v1/aster/triage
{
  "conversation": "...",
  "vitals": {"hr": 88},
  "stream": true
}

noah_s: I'll request 50 labeled examples per flow from AsterBio and run A/B vs their baseline. Evals will be deterministic and reproducible.

omar_r: Provisioning note: reserving a small dedicated pool for staging now. I'll upload cost workbook in the shared drive.

sec-bot: Legal flag: customer-managed HSM requirement may mandate Private; legal review required. Also add clause: no full patient identifiers in logs by default.

taylor_p: Good. I'll draft SOW with trial cap (500k tokens), flat trial fee and clear overage. Will ask AsterBio to sign by EOD Fri to meet timeline. Reply here once artifacts are uploaded.
